posts.name: Pydro
posts.cooked:
After a few battles together, the heroes start to become a team, I think those teams should get a name. In this event, choose a three hero team from the heroes available in the app, there are 165 combinations. If you win three games with those heroes against three different villains, you get to pick the name of that three hero team. If you lose, you can keep trying until you get three wins. Let's see if all 165 teams can get names!

When you have named your team, please post the name and matches here too!

Form

Sheet

 

 

Also, don't forget to add the team to Event #21!

Did two groups so far.  First one was Haka, Wraith, and AZ or team Whaz! against Ambuscade, Baron Blade, and Omnitron.  In some of the matches I think Haka and AZ hurt themselves more than the villain

 

 

The second group was Viz, Ra, and AZ known as the team It burns when I Viz faced Ambuscade, Baron Blade, and Bomber Blade.  A bit of a slow setup but this team felt rather dominant after the second round.  

 

I played all of my matches in Silver Gulch.

I was working towards your second team

To ninja is (to me) rather mean

I'd conquered Mad Bomber Blade

and fought Voss in the shade

and was working fry Dawnie's spleen.

 

 

(In all seriousness, though, my game against Voss was epic.  I dropped him with exact damage, with Visionary and Ra incapped and AZ at 1.  Thank goodness for Phosphorescent Chamber.

posts.name: metlarcturus
posts.cooked: Team GoGo Gadget! took to the field. Wraith, Bunker, and Absolute Zero; just think of all the equipment! They dealt a stinging loss to Grand Warlord Voss on Mars, then crashed the Citizens of the Sun party on Insula Primalis (poor Dawn never got her Aurora on). Then, in a feat some would call suicidal, they took on Omnitron in Silver Gulch. The first two battles, Terraforming and Tech Singularities wrecked Team GoGo Gadget!, but third time was the charm. Gingerly firing around two carts of dynamite, our gear-happy heroes prevailed.

posts.cooked: Team Brutal Sacrifice consisting of Legacy, Fanatic, and Haka beat down Baron Blade, Grand Warlord Voss, and Citizen Dawn in Silver Gulch.  The game against Voss had not one but two uses of End of Days to get rid of Voss's battleships since only Fanatic could deal damage to them.  Blade was only a minor issue since he drew a second MDP at the start.  Dawn took two attempts as Fanatic never drew any Ongoing destruction and Haka didn't get Savage Mana so a beginning Return wiht the Dawn was trouble as it seemed Citizen Truth or Citizen Anvil were the one that came back.  The seidbd game I did get a savage mana and was able to cobble citizens.  It ended with Haka going on a rampage and spitting Citizens back at Dawn along with Sheriff Pratt.
